success_criterion.definition: A cell passes the bistability criterion when exactly two Morse nodes have a stable Conley-index signature, identified by a nonzero degree-0 component. Higher-degree components may be nonzero; for example, both (x^4-1, 0, 0) and (x-1, x-1, 0) qualify. Graph edges/minimality and sampled tolerance metrics are diagnostics and do not affect this classification.
success_criterion.name: bistability_exactly_two_stable_conley_index_nodes
